message.content:
I don't recall having any fever or chills. And I don't think I've had any pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath. 

As for my legs, they don't seem swollen or painful. I haven't done any long travel recently, and I haven't had any surgery. I don't remember ever having blood clots before.
